Guides

Terminal browser

Browse, preview, and apply your profiles without leaving the terminal.

Terminal
ghostty-wall tui

Find your way around#

Type a key name and press Enter. The browser supports these controls:

KeyAction
j / kMove through profiles
tabSwitch pane
enterPreview the selected profile
aApply the previewed profile
bGo back
qQuit

Image previews#

Image previews use Ghostty’s Kitty graphics protocol when available. In other environments, the browser falls back to a text preview.

Random profiles#

Terminal
ghostty-wall tui --seed 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f

Pass a seed when browsing profiles that use random wallpaper selection. A seed is 32 bytes, written as 64 hex digits.
